entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CA1822, Member can be static, incorrectly firing for instance extension member #81564
  • `SyntaxFacts.IsOnHeader` failure while typing a new expression member in a new file #81563
  • Remove dependency on Newtonsoft.Json from Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces.MSBuild.BuildHost project #81561
  • "Extract Method" changes the behavior of a VB.NET program #81557
  • In the regex prompt, there's a small typo: the carriage return escape sequence should be \r, not \rr. #81555
  • IDE0059 message is not correct for C#14 extension method #81554
  • NullableWalker assert failure with a collection expression passed to params collection #81552
    18.3

Closed

  • Implicit conversion of string to ReadOnlySpan<char> fails in simplified LINQ #81559
  • CS8784 and CS8785 severity can not be changed to error via .editorconfig #81479
    18.3
  • CS0592 for NotNullWhen on extension property #81543
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11304.96 #81548

PullRequests

Created

  • Don't subscribe to the RDT just to unsubscribe #81567
    Area-IDE
  • Switch the fetch of the Running Document Table to the UI thread again #81566
    Area-IDE
  • Merge vs-extension-testing into Roslyn #81565
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Remove dependency on Newtonsoft.Json from Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces.MSBuild.BuildHost #81562
    VSCode
  • [MSBuild Host] Remove dependency on System.CommandLine #81560
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix regex escape sequence typo in Simplified Chinese localization #81556
    Area-IDE
  • [release/dev18.0] Consider PATH again when searching for dotnet host #81553

Merged

  • Add willRenameFiles support, and an abstraction for extenders to implement #81549
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Further clean up Roslyn's package load #80598
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Support `// lang=c#` along with `// lang=c#-test` #81558
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Generate docs - fix an issue where the suggestion session was being overtaken #81537
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Build our libraries against net10.0 #81545
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81551

Updated

  • Ensure calls to OOP for source-generator purposes see the exact same Solution-snapshot-instances across all calls they make #81529
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use ArrayExpansion for fixed buffer fields #81536
    Area-Interactive, Community
  • Unsafe evolution: add `MemorySafetyRules` attribute #81441
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Implement exhaustiveness check for Union types #81442
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Closed Class Hierarchies, Feature - Unions
  • Ref-safety for `with(...)` elements. #81542
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Add separate error for disallowed members in global namespace #81221
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81478
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
